reason: Reviewed the CLI agent surface after the protocol package became the one declaration of the served REST wire. api.ts now carries what the service actually accepts and returns: the alpha access request view with its distribution lanes and public-purchase flag replaces the narrower account-access view, pairing details admit the stopped status, content media items expose preview and dimension fields, and the project update request drops an image field the service never accepted; the CLI's client type import follows the one rename. The package also exports its push-envelope builders so the service renders from the code offline pre-flight estimates with; the CLI's own imports and behavior are unchanged. close names question ids beside request ids in its positional and usage errors, matching status and the skill's teaching that a held q_ id resolves without registering a duplicate question. The push-envelope estimator reserves created_at so offline pre-flight agrees with the service's size check, and the unemitted billing_duplicate_channel code left the error vocabulary. Unused exports, unreferenced barrel re-exports, an unused theme alias, and two unused types were deleted with their orphaned imports; every command, hook, and flag they named is still exported from its own module. No lifecycle hook, skill wording, harness setup, readiness state, acknowledgement, or continuation behavior changed, and the skill text is untouched.
